# Implementation Plan: BNP (Bike Number Plate) Full-Stack E-Commerce & Admin Platform

A high-performance, sensory-designed, full-stack e-commerce web application and administration portal for **BNP: Bike Number Plate** (*A Joy & Arash Enterprise Venture*), accessible at `bnp.shop` and backed by cPanel MySQL and the LoraHost Payment Bridge.

---

## Goal Description

Build and deploy a complete, production-grade e-commerce application for **BNP: Bike Number Plate** ([bnp.shop](https://bnp.shop)), offering custom laser-cut mirror-silver steel and BRTA-compliant aluminum motorcycle and scooter plates in Bangladesh. 

The project delivers:
1. **Award-Winning Sensory One-Page Storefront**: Implemented following the Biological UI / Sensory tactile philosophy, featuring a live interactive metallic plate designer, English-to-Bangla real-time smart transliteration, BRTA compliance urgency counter, retail and wholesale dealer pricing tiers, streamlined order intake with mandatory WhatsApp registration-paper verification, and dual payment rails (automatic LoraHost Payment Bridge relay + manual bKash/Nagad fallback).
2. **Robust Backend & Database**: Powered by Next.js 14+ App Router API routes, cPanel MySQL with parameterized queries, server-side pricing recalculation, cryptographic HMAC return verification, and raw-body webhook signature validation.
3. **Automated Discord Dispatcher**: Server-side dispatch of rich embeds on verified transactions to notify the operations team instantly.
4. **Custom Administrative Portal (`/admin/*`)**: Secure bcrypt-authenticated management dashboard for searching, filtering, and updating order statuses (New, Confirmed, Printed, Shipped, Delivered) with direct WhatsApp customer chat links, alongside a live store settings configurator.
5. **Strict Git & Milestone Discipline**: Every phase delivered as a distinct commit, pushed to GitHub ([Maijied/BNP](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP)), and opened as an isolated pull request with **strictly zero AI attribution**, no skip-CI markers, and zero policy drift.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph Client ["Client Browser (Mobile-First / Facebook Traffic)"]
        UI["Urgency Bar & Hero"]
        PD["Plate Designer (Model A / B)"]
        Bangla["lib/bengali.ts (English -> Bangla)"]
        Order["Order Form (Pathao Courier + Bracket)"]
        WA_Notice["WhatsApp Reg-Paper Notice"]
    end

    subgraph Server ["Next.js 14+ App Router (Vercel / Node)"]
        API_Order["POST /api/order"]
        API_Return["GET /payment/return (HMAC Check)"]
        API_Webhook["POST /api/payment/webhook (X-Signature Check)"]
        Discord["Discord Webhook Relay"]
        Admin_Auth["/api/admin/auth (JWT Cookie)"]
        Admin_API["/api/admin/orders & settings"]
    end

    subgraph Database ["HostNF cPanel MySQL (HostNF Hosting)"]
        DB_Orders[("orders table")]
        DB_Settings[("settings table")]
        DB_Admins[("admins table")]
    end

    subgraph External ["External Services & Partners"]
        LoraHost["LoraHost Payment Bridge (PayStation: bKash, Nagad, Cards)"]
        Discord_Channel["Discord Private Admin Channel"]
        WhatsApp_Shop["WhatsApp Verification (01914-873925)"]
    end

    UI --> PD
    PD <--> Bangla
    PD --> Order
    Order --> WA_Notice
    Order -->|1. Submit Order| API_Order
    API_Order -->|Validate & Insert pending_payment| DB_Orders
    API_Order -->|Read Pricing & Config| DB_Settings
    API_Order -->|2. Create Session (Bearer Token)| LoraHost
    LoraHost -->|Return checkout_url| API_Order
    API_Order -->|Redirect Customer| LoraHost
    LoraHost -->|3. Browser Return (sig)| API_Return
    API_Return -->|Verify Return HMAC & Update Order| DB_Orders
    LoraHost -->|4. Async Signed Webhook (X-Signature)| API_Webhook
    API_Webhook -->|Raw HMAC Verify & Mark Paid| DB_Orders
    API_Webhook -->|5. Instant Sale Alert Embed| Discord
    Discord --> Discord_Channel
    Admin_Auth <--> DB_Admins
    Admin_API <--> DB_Orders & DB_Settings
```

---

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Database Architecture (cPanel MySQL)**:
> In strict accordance with the project specification, this project connects directly to **cPanel MySQL** (`hostnf` hosting) via `mysql2/promise` with parameterized queries. No BaaS (Supabase, Firebase) is used for database storage. Please confirm that your cPanel MySQL host allows remote connections from Vercel (or whether this project will be deployed as a standalone Node.js app within cPanel Passenger).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **LoraHost Payment Bridge Credentials**:
> Session creation, return validation, and webhook verification require the following environment variables:
> - `LORA_BRIDGE_URL` (`https://lorahost.lorapok.tech`)
> - `LORA_BRIDGE_CLIENT_TOKEN` (Bearer client token for partner `bnp`)
> - `LORA_RETURN_HMAC_TOKEN` (HMAC secret for return URL query string)
> - `LORA_WEBHOOK_HMAC_TOKEN` (HMAC secret for raw-body `X-LoraHost-Signature`)
> When deploying to production, these must be configured in your environment; mock/fallback modes will be provided for local testing without breaking the build.

> [!WARNING]
> **Strict No-AI-Attribution Version Control Policy**:
> All commits, branches, PR titles, PR descriptions, and code files will strictly omit any Claude Code, Antigravity, or AI tags, trailers (`Co-Authored-By`), or badges.

---

## Open Questions

> [!NOTE]
> 1. **Delivery Zone Structure**: The base delivery fee in the sample invoice is `60 BDT` (inside Dhaka). For outside Dhaka (nationwide Pathao courier), should we offer a toggle (e.g. Inside Dhaka `60 BDT` / Outside Dhaka `120 BDT`), or a single flat passed-through rate configured in `settings`? (Recommended: 2-tier toggle Inside Dhaka 60 / Outside Dhaka 120, fully editable via `/admin/settings`).
> 2. **Initial Admin Credentials**: To seed the `admins` table upon initial migration, what default admin email should be created (e.g. `bikesnumberplate@gmail.com` or `admin@bnp.shop`)? We will provide a secure CLI seeding script (`npm run seed:admin`) that bcrypt-hashes a password interactively or from env.

---

## Proposed Changes

The implementation will be executed across 7 modular, independently verifiable milestones. Each milestone will result in a clean commit and separate PR pushed to [Maijied/BNP](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP).

---

### Milestone 1: Foundation, Design System & App Shell

Scaffold the Next.js 14+ project, configure typography, install design tokens, establish the full carbon-black and mirror-silver luxury theme, and lay out component shells.

#### [NEW] `package.json`
- Next.js 14+ (App Router), React 18/19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, `framer-motion`, `lucide-react`, `mysql2`, `bcryptjs`, `jose`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`.
- Scripts: `dev`, `build`, `start`, `lint`, `db:migrate`, `seed:admin`.

#### [NEW] `tailwind.config.ts`
- Custom palette:
  - Carbon Black: `#0B0B0C`, `#121214`, `#18191D`, `#222329`
  - BNP Crimson Red: `#E11D2E`, `#EF233C`
  - Mirror Silver gradients: `#F8FAFC`, `#E2E8F0`, `#94A3B8`, `#475569`
  - Gold Micro-highlights: `#D4AF37`, `#F59E0B`
- Glassmorphism backdrops, metallic text shadows, and embossed plate drop shadows.

#### [NEW] `app/layout.tsx`
- Load **Hind Siliguri** (Bangla charset + numerals) and **Sora** / **Space Grotesk** via `next/font/google`.
- SEO Metadata: OpenGraph, Twitter cards, Apple Touch Icons, Title: *"BNP | Bike Number Plate — Premium Quality Mirror Silver Steel Plates"*.

#### [NEW] `.env.example`
- Template containing all required environment variables:
  `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`, `MYSQL_HOST`, `MYSQL_PORT`, `MYSQL_USER`, `MYSQL_PASSWORD`, `MYSQL_DATABASE`, `LORA_BRIDGE_URL`, `LORA_BRIDGE_CLIENT_TOKEN`, `LORA_RETURN_HMAC_TOKEN`, `LORA_WEBHOOK_HMAC_TOKEN`, `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL`, `ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET`, `ADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL`.

#### [NEW] `.gitignore`
- Exclude `node_modules`, `.next`, `.env`, `.env.local`, `.env.*.local`, `.DS_Store`, and temporary test files.

---

### Milestone 2: Bengali Transliteration & Live Plate Designer

Build the centerpiece feature: a realistic, sensory-tactile interactive plate designer with real-time English-to-Bangla auto-conversion.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    UserInput["User types: 'Dhaka Metro LA 12 3456'"]
    Lexer["English-to-Bangla Transliteration Engine (lib/bengali.ts)"]
    Parsed["Region: ঢাকা মেট্রো | Serial: ল | Part 1: ১২ | Part 2: ৩৪৫৬"]
    Preview["Live Plate Canvas / CSS Shader (Model A: 285x50 / Model B: 200x100)"]

    UserInput --> Lexer
    Lexer --> Parsed
    Parsed --> Preview
```

#### [NEW] `lib/bengali.ts`
- Transliteration dictionary for all 64 Bangladesh districts & metropolitan zones:
  - `Dhaka Metro` / `DM` -> `ঢাকা মেট্রো`
  - `Chattogram Metro` / `CTG` -> `চট্টগ্রাম মেট্রো`
  - `Cumilla` -> `কুমিল্লা`, `Sylhet` -> `সিলেট`, `Rajshahi` -> `রাজশাহী`, `Khulna` -> `খুলনা`, `Barishal` -> `বরিশাল`, `Rangpur` -> `রংপুর`, `Mymensingh` -> `ময়মনসিংহ`.
- Vehicle class letters mapping:
  - `HA` / `H` -> `হ`
  - `LA` / `L` -> `ল`
  - `GA` / `G` -> `গ`
  - `KHA` -> `খ`, `GHA` -> `ঘ`, `CHA` -> `চ`, `DA` -> `ড`, etc.
- Digits conversion: `0-9` to `০-৯`.
- Dual-mode support: Seamlessly handles direct Bangla keyboard typing as well as auto-translating English input.

#### [NEW] `components/PlateDesigner.tsx`
- Aspect ratio toggles:
  - **Model A (Motorcycle)**: 285 x 50 mm ratio (5.7 : 1), single-line stamped layout.
  - **Model B (Scooter)**: 200 x 100 mm ratio (2 : 1), two-line stamped layout.
- Photorealistic metallic shader:
  - Multi-stop linear silver/chrome gradient with specular highlight sweep.
  - Embossed stamped text effect with dual shadows (inset highlight top-left, dark drop shadow bottom-right).
  - BRTA standard mounting holes (2 x 12 x 5.5 mm slots) rendered at exact scale.
  - Animated number stamp-in micro-interaction via Framer Motion.
- Technical specs overlay: 0.8 mm Mirror Silver Steel, Finish No. 8, Laser Edge, BRTA Front Plate Compatible.

---

### Milestone 3: Storefront Sections & Order Intake Experience

Assemble the full one-page storefront in the exact sequence specified by the design architecture.

#### [NEW] `components/UrgencyBar.tsx`
- Top notification banner: *"BRTA deadline: November 15 — order your compliant plate today"* + Hotline click-to-call: `01632333221`.
- Dynamic fallback to `settings` table with local default.

#### [NEW] `components/Navbar.tsx`
- Brand mark: BNP | Bike Number Plate, *"A Joy & Arash Enterprise Venture"*.
- Navigation anchors: Designer, Pricing, Wholesale, Order, Hotline.

#### [NEW] `components/Hero.tsx`
- Cinematic hero with 3D-styled metallic plate render, metallic badges (*0.8mm Stainless Steel*, *Finish No. 8*, *Laser Cut*), tagline *"Premium Quality | Durable | Stylish"*, and CTA button leading directly to the designer.

#### [NEW] `components/Pricing.tsx`
- Retail Cards:
  - Model A (Motorcycle 285x50 mm): **380 BDT** (Pre-order: **300 BDT**).
  - Model B (Scooter 200x100 mm): **450 BDT** (Pre-order: **380 BDT**).
  - Mounting Kit Addon: **+80 BDT** (Clamp bracket + high-tensile bolts & washers).
- B2B Wholesale Tier Matrix (Dealer rates from 65 BDT/pc at 400 pcs up to 80 BDT/pc) with direct WhatsApp order button for bulk inquiries.

#### [NEW] `components/OrderForm.tsx`
- Synchronized with the Plate Designer.
- Form inputs: Customer Name, Shop Name (optional), Mobile Number (validation: `^01[3-9]\d{8}$`), Delivery District (64 districts dropdown), Detailed Street Address, Plate Model selection, Plate Number, Quantity, Bracket Addon (checkbox).
- Live pricing calculator (display only; verified server-side).
- **Mandatory WhatsApp Registration Notice Box**:
  - High-visibility amber/red card: *"⚠️ BRTA Verification Requirement: After placing your order, send a clear photo of your bike registration card/paper via WhatsApp to 01914-873925. Plates are manufactured strictly matching your legal paper."*

#### [NEW] `components/PaymentSection.tsx`
- Full advance payment policy notice (strictly no COD).
- Primary: **LoraHost Payment Bridge** (PayStation: bKash, Nagad, Visa, Mastercard, AMEX).
- Fallback Accordion: Manual bKash/Nagad Personal Send Money to `01632333221` with fields for Sender Number & Transaction ID.

#### [NEW] `components/FAQ.tsx`
- 6 key customer questions: Legal compliance with BRTA rules, delivery timelines (Pathao 24-48h Dhaka / 48-72h outside), plate durability & rust resistance, mounting bracket installation, payment security.

#### [NEW] `components/Footer.tsx`
- Brand attribution: *"A Joy & Arash Enterprise Venture"* (Founders: Joy & Arash).
- Hotline: `01632333221` | WhatsApp: `01914-873925` | Email: `bikesnumberplate@gmail.com`.
- Address: `52 Purana Paltan Line, Paltan, Dhaka` | Facebook: `facebook.com/bikenumberplate`.

#### [NEW] `components/WhatsAppFloat.tsx`
- Fixed bottom-right glowing WhatsApp bubble linking to pre-composed message with order reference.

#### [NEW] `app/page.tsx`
- Compose all sections in the exact mandatory sequence with smooth-scroll anchors and responsive padding.

---

### Milestone 4: MySQL Database & LoraHost Payment Bridge

Build the persistent data layer on cPanel MySQL and implement the server-side LoraHost Payment Bridge integration.

#### [NEW] `lib/db.ts`
- MySQL connection pool via `mysql2/promise`.
- Robust parameterized query helper `query(sql, params)`.
- Reconnect and retry handlers for cPanel MySQL hosting.

#### [NEW] `scripts/migrate.sql`
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  order_number VARCHAR(32) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  shop_name VARCHAR(120) NULL,
  phone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  district VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  address TEXT NOT NULL,
  model ENUM('A', 'B') NOT NULL,
  reg_number_bangla VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  reg_number_english VARCHAR(80) NULL,
  quantity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  bracket TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
  unit_price INT NOT NULL,
  plate_total INT NOT NULL,
  bracket_total INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  delivery_charge INT NOT NULL,
  total INT NOT NULL,
  payment_status ENUM('pending_payment', 'verifying', 'paid', 'failed') DEFAULT 'pending_payment',
  payment_method VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'lorahost_bridge',
  lora_session_id VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  lora_trx_id VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  trx_note VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  status ENUM('new', 'confirmed', 'printed', 'shipped', 'delivered') DEFAULT 'new',
  notes TEXT NULL,
  INDEX idx_phone (phone),
  INDEX idx_order_number (order_number),
  INDEX idx_created_at (created_at)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
  k VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
  v TEXT NOT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admins (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  email VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Initial settings seed
INSERT INTO settings (k, v) VALUES
  ('price_a', '380'),
  ('price_b', '450'),
  ('price_preorder_a', '300'),
  ('price_preorder_b', '380'),
  ('bracket_price', '80'),
  ('delivery_dhaka', '60'),
  ('delivery_outside', '120'),
  ('urgency_text', 'BRTA deadline: November 15 - order your compliant plate today'),
  ('hotline', '01632333221'),
  ('whatsapp', '01914-873925')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE k=k;
```

#### [NEW] `lib/lorahost.ts`
- **Session Creator**:
  - Sends `POST https://lorahost.lorapok.tech/api/payment-bridge/v1/sessions`.
  - Header: `Authorization: Bearer ${process.env.LORA_BRIDGE_CLIENT_TOKEN}`.
  - JSON Payload:
    ```json
    {
      "reference": "BNP-20261101-ABCD",
      "amount": 520,
      "return_url": "https://bnp.shop/payment/return",
      "customer": {
        "name": "Customer Name",
        "phone": "017XXXXXXXX"
      }
    }
    ```
  - Handles response: retrieves `checkout_url` and `session_id`.
  - Retry logic for `409 duplicate invoice`: creates fresh reference with a distinct nonce.
- **Return HMAC Signature Verifier**:
  - Canonical alphabetized query string sorting (excluding `sig`).
  - Computes `crypto.createHmac('sha256', LORA_RETURN_HMAC_TOKEN).update(canonicalString).digest('hex')`.
  - Verifies in constant time using `crypto.timingSafeEqual`.
- **Webhook Signature Verifier**:
  - Computes HMAC SHA-256 of the raw unparsed JSON request body with `LORA_WEBHOOK_HMAC_TOKEN`.
  - Compares against the `X-LoraHost-Signature` header.

#### [NEW] `app/api/order/route.ts`
- Server-side validation of all customer inputs (phone regex, quantity limits, sanitized address).
- Server-side price recalculation querying `settings` table (never trusts client price).
- Inserts order as `pending_payment`.
- Calls `createBridgeSession()` and returns `{ checkout_url, order_number }`.
- If manual payment chosen, marks as `verifying` with transaction ID and redirects to success screen.

#### [NEW] `app/payment/return/page.tsx` & `app/api/payment/webhook/route.ts`
- Return route validates HMAC signature, updates order in database, and renders `/payment/success` or `/payment/failed`.
- Webhook route parses raw body, verifies `X-LoraHost-Signature`, idempotently transitions order to `paid`, updates `lora_trx_id`, and triggers Discord alert.

---

### Milestone 5: Discord Webhook Dispatcher & Confirmation Pages

#### [NEW] `lib/discord.ts`
- Server-side notification utility:
  ```typescript
  export async function sendOrderDiscordNotification(order: OrderRecord) {
    if (!process.env.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL) return;
    const embed = {
      title: "🚀 New Paid Order: " + order.order_number,
      color: 0xE11D2E,
      fields: [
        { name: "Customer", value: `${order.name} (${order.phone})`, inline: true },
        { name: "District", value: order.district, inline: true },
        { name: "Model", value: `Model ${order.model} (${order.model === 'A' ? '285x50mm' : '200x100mm'})`, inline: true },
        { name: "Plate Number", value: `**${order.reg_number_bangla}**`, inline: false },
        { name: "Bracket Addon", value: order.bracket ? "✅ Yes (+80 BDT)" : "❌ No", inline: true },
        { name: "Total Amount", value: `**৳ ${order.total} BDT**`, inline: true },
        { name: "Transaction ID", value: order.lora_trx_id || order.trx_note || "N/A", inline: true },
        { name: "WhatsApp Paper Check", value: `[Open WhatsApp Chat](https://wa.me/88${order.phone})`, inline: false }
      ],
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      footer: { text: "BNP | Joy & Arash Enterprise" }
    };
    await fetch(process.env.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ embeds: [embed] })
    });
  }
  ```

#### [NEW] `app/payment/success/page.tsx` & `app/payment/failed/page.tsx`
- Success: Visual invoice slip, green checkmark animation, button to download receipt, and one-click WhatsApp button with pre-filled message: *"Hello BNP, I completed payment for Order [BNP-XXXX]. Here is the photo of my bike registration paper: [Attach Photo]"*.
- Failed: Friendly error explanation, retry payment button, and instructions to complete via manual Send Money.

---

### Milestone 6: Admin Portal & Store Settings Management

A full administrative suite to monitor orders, advance manufacturing states, and adjust prices.

#### [NEW] `lib/admin-auth.ts`
- Bcrypt verification against `admins` table.
- Issues secure, signed, HttpOnly session cookie (`bnp_admin_session`) using `jose`.
- Middleware `/middleware.ts` guarding all `/admin/*` routes except `/admin/login`.

#### [NEW] `app/admin/login/page.tsx`
- Minimalist dark aesthetic login page with email, password, and error alerts.

#### [NEW] `app/admin/orders/page.tsx`
- Real-time orders table:
  - Search by mobile number, order ID, or registration number.
  - Filter by `payment_status` (`pending_payment`, `verifying`, `paid`, `failed`) and `status` (`new`, `confirmed`, `printed`, `shipped`, `delivered`).
  - One-click status updater dropdown.
  - "Chat on WhatsApp" quick link for each customer.
  - Expandable row showing full delivery address, bracket status, and transaction references.

#### [NEW] `app/admin/settings/page.tsx`
- Key-value config editor for:
  - Model A Retail & Pre-order Price
  - Model B Retail & Pre-order Price
  - Mounting Bracket Price
  - Delivery Fees (Inside/Outside Dhaka)
  - Urgency Banner Text
  - Hotline & WhatsApp Contact Numbers

#### [NEW] `app/api/admin/orders/[id]/route.ts` & `app/api/admin/settings/route.ts`
- Authenticated endpoints supporting status updates and dynamic settings modification.

---

### Milestone 7: Optimization, Build Verification & Deployment Runbook

Final hardening, production build verification, and deployment documentation for HostNF cPanel + Vercel.

#### [NEW] `docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md`
- Step-by-step instructions for:
  1. Importing `scripts/migrate.sql` into HostNF cPanel MySQL via phpMyAdmin.
  2. Setting up environment variables in Vercel or cPanel Node.js Application Manager.
  3. Configuring LoraHost Payment Bridge partner dashboard:
     - Partner ID: `bnp`
     - Display Name: `BNP`
     - Return Hosts: `bnp.shop`, `localhost:3000`
     - Webhook URL: `https://bnp.shop/api/payment/webhook`
  4. Pointing DNS records from HostNF domain registrar to Vercel.
  5. Running the live 1 BDT end-to-end verification test.

---

## Verification Plan

### Automated Tests
1. **Next.js Production Build**:
   ```bash
   npm run build
   ```

args.Content:
# BNP — Bike Number Plate

> **A Joy & Arash Enterprise Venture**  
> Premium Quality | Durable | Stylish  
> Official Website: [bnp.shop](https://bnp.shop)

---

## Overview

BNP (Bike Number Plate) is a modern full-stack e-commerce platform and administration portal engineered for custom, laser-cut mirror-silver stainless steel (0.8 mm, Finish No. 8) and BRTA-compliant aluminum motorcycle and scooter number plates in Bangladesh.

### Key Features

- **Sensory Interactive Plate Designer**: Real-time metallic plate visualization for Model A (Motorcycle: 285×50 mm) and Model B (Scooter: 200×100 mm).
- **Bangla Smart Transliteration Engine**: Real-time phonetic parsing that automatically converts English input (e.g. `Dhaka Metro LA 12 3456`) to valid BRTA Bangla format (`ঢাকা মেট্রো-ল-১২-৩৪৫৬`).
- **Full-Stack Order Pipeline**: Streamlined order placement with Pathao courier delivery calculation and mandatory WhatsApp registration verification.
- **LoraHost Payment Bridge Integration**: Automatic checkout session routing via PayStation (bKash, Nagad, cards) with cryptographic HMAC return and raw-body webhook signature verification.
- **Manual Payment Fallback**: Integrated bKash / Nagad Send Money verification with Transaction ID logging.
- **Discord Dispatcher**: Server-side webhook notifications delivering instant order embeds to private team channels.
- **Administrative Portal (`/admin`)**: Secure, bcrypt-authenticated dashboard for searching, filtering, and advancing order statuses (New, Confirmed, Printed, Shipped, Delivered) with direct WhatsApp customer chat links and dynamic settings management.

---

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 14+ (App Router, TypeScript, React)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide Icons
- **Typography**: Hind Siliguri (Bangla), Sora / Space Grotesk (Headings)
- **Database**: cPanel MySQL via `mysql2` parameterized queries
- **Security**: Bcrypt password hashing, signed HTTP-only cookies, HMAC SHA-256 webhook validation
- **Deployment**: Vercel (Frontend & Serverless API) + HostNF cPanel (MySQL)

---

## Environment Variables

Copy `.env.example` to `.env.local` and configure your credentials:

```bash
cp .env.example .env.local
```

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` | Canonical public URL (e.g. `https://bnp.shop`) |
| `MYSQL_HOST` | MySQL database host |
| `MYSQL_PORT` | MySQL port (default: 3306) |
| `MYSQL_USER` | MySQL database user |
| `MYSQL_PASSWORD` | MySQL database password |
| `MYSQL_DATABASE` | MySQL database name (`bnp_shop`) |
| `LORA_BRIDGE_URL` | LoraHost Payment Bridge endpoint |
| `LORA_BRIDGE_CLIENT_TOKEN` | Bearer authorization client token |
| `LORA_RETURN_HMAC_TOKEN` | Secret key for return query signature verification |
| `LORA_WEBHOOK_HMAC_TOKEN` | Secret key for raw webhook signature verification |
| `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL` | Discord webhook URL for instant order alerts |
| `ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET` | Secret key for signed admin session cookies |
| `ADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL` | Default administrator account email |

---

## Getting Started

### 1. Install Dependencies

```bash
npm install
```

### 2. Run Database Migrations

```bash
npm run db:migrate
```

### 3. Start Local Development Server

```bash
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser.

---

Building `lib/lorahost.ts` requires implementing a session creation function. This function will make a POST request to a specified API endpoint with a bearer token for authorization. The request body will include a reference, amount, return URL, and customer details, likely in JSON format.

The route handler needs validation for the order data. These checks include string validations for name, district, address and registration number as well as regex for phone number. Additional validations cover model type, quantity, bracket and payment method.

Building the return route to handle the redirection from the payment service. The route will validate incoming query parameters, specifically checking a cryptographic signature for data integrity. Successful signature verification triggers status updates: a 'success' status indicates the order payment status needs to be updated to 'paid'.

The endpoint `/api/payment/webhook` will handle incoming payment webhooks. It verifies the signature of the incoming request body against a header. Upon successful signature verification, the endpoint parses the JSON body and updates a payment record based on the received data. A failure to verify the signature will return a 401 error.

## 3. Key Findings & Decisions
- **cPanel MySQL with Memory Fallback**: Built `lib/db.ts` to seamlessly use MySQL pool when configured (`MYSQL_HOST`, `MYSQL_USER`, `MYSQL_PASSWORD`, `MYSQL_DATABASE`), while providing an in-memory mock store when database credentials are not present in local dev or CI. This prevents runtime crashes during static prerendering.
- **Server-Side Pricing Validation**: Total amounts are strictly recalculated server-side in `app/api/order/route.ts` based on the `settings` table/defaults; client prices are treated as display-only to prevent tampering.
- **HMAC Signatures**:
  - Return URL signature is calculated over canonical sorted query parameters excluding `sig` using `LORA_RETURN_HMAC_TOKEN`.
  - Webhook signature is calculated over the raw string body (via `req.text()`) using `LORA_WEBHOOK_HMAC_TOKEN`.
- **409 Duplicate Invoice Handling**: Handled in `lib/lorahost.ts` by generating a fresh reference with an appended retry nonce (`-R1`, `-R2`) rather than reusing `session_id`.

---

1. **ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pypdf'**:
   - *Cause*: Python environment lacked `pypdf`.
   - *Fix*: Used native `/usr/bin/pdftotext` to extract text from `BFNP_Archive_Finance_Master_Tracker_Duplicate.pdf.pdf` and `BFNP_Interactive_Dataset_Cost_and_Financial_Breakdown_Tracker.pdf.pdf`.

# BNP: Bike Number Plate — Production Deployment & Operations Runbook

**A Joy & Arash Enterprise Venture**  
**Products**: Laser-cut 0.8 mm Finish No. 8 mirror-silver steel and BRTA-compliant aluminum motorcycle and scooter plates in Bangladesh.  
**Official Channels**:  
- Hotline & bKash Send Money: `01632333221`  
- WhatsApp Registration Certificate Intake: `01914-873925`  
- Official Email: `bikesnumberplate@gmail.com`  
- Physical Workshop / Office: `52 Purana Paltan Line, Paltan, Dhaka`  

---

## 1. System Architecture Overview

```
                      +------------------------------------------+
                      |         Customer Browser (Web/Mobile)    |
                      +------------------------------------------+
                                           |
                                           v
                      +------------------------------------------+
                      |       Next.js 14 App Router (Node.js)    |
                      |  - Interactive Plate Designer            |
                      |  - Bengali Transliteration Engine        |
                      |  - Order Intake & Server Validation      |
                      |  - Admin Dashboard (/admin/orders)       |
                      |  - Settings Configurator (/admin/settings|
                      +------------------------------------------+
                        /            |             \           \
                       /             |              \           \
                      v              v               v           v
          +---------------+  +---------------+  +---------+  +-----------+
          | cPanel MySQL  |  |   LoraHost    |  | Discord |  | Customer  |
          |  (orders,     |  | Payment Bridge|  | Webhook |  | WhatsApp  |
          |   settings,   |  | (PayStation/  |  | Realtime|  | Bluebook  |
          |   admins)     |  |  bKash/Nagad) |  | Alerts  |  | Intake    |
          +---------------+  +---------------+  +---------+  +-----------+
```

---

## 2. Environment Configuration

Create `.env.local` for local development or configure environment variables in your production host (Vercel, Cloudflare, cPanel Node.js Application Manager, or Docker):

| Variable Key | Required | Default / Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` | Yes | Production URL (e.g. `https://bnp.shop` or `https://bikesnumberplate.com`) |
| `MYSQL_HOST` | Yes | cPanel/HostNF MySQL hostname (e.g., `localhost` or server IP/hostname) |
| `MYSQL_PORT` | No | `3306` |
| `MYSQL_USER` | Yes | Database username (e.g., `bnp_user`) |
| `MYSQL_PASSWORD` | Yes | Database user password |
| `MYSQL_DATABASE` | Yes | Database name (e.g., `bnp_shop`) |
| `LORA_BRIDGE_URL` | Yes | `https://lorahost.lorapok.tech` |
| `LORA_BRIDGE_CLIENT_TOKEN` | Yes | Client bearer token provided by LoraHost |
| `LORA_RETURN_HMAC_TOKEN` | Yes | HMAC secret for verifying redirect query signatures |
| `LORA_WEBHOOK_HMAC_TOKEN` | Yes | HMAC secret for verifying server-to-server webhook callbacks |
| `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL` | Yes | Incoming Discord Webhook URL for real-time order alerts |
| `ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET` | Yes | Random 32+ character string for signing JWT admin cookies |
| `ADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL` | No | Initial admin login email (`bikesnumberplate@gmail.com`) |
| `ADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD` | No | Initial admin login password |

---

## 3. Database Setup (cPanel / phpMyAdmin / Remote MySQL)

### Step 3.1: Create MySQL Database and User
1. Log in to cPanel -> **MySQL Database Wizard**.
2. Create database: `username_bnp_shop`.
3. Create user: `username_bnp_user` with a strong password.
4. Add user to database with **ALL PRIVILEGES**.
5. If Next.js runs externally (e.g. Vercel), open **Remote MySQL** in cPanel and add `%` or your deployment egress IP addresses.

### Step 3.2: Run Database Migration
Execute the schema script located at `scripts/migrate.sql`. You can do this in two ways:

**Option A (phpMyAdmin):**
1. Open cPanel -> **phpMyAdmin**.
2. Select `username_bnp_shop`.
3. Click **Import** -> Select `scripts/migrate.sql` -> Click **Go**.

**Option B (CLI):**
```bash
MYSQL_HOST=your-host MYSQL_USER=username_bnp_user MYSQL_PASSWORD=REDACTED MYSQL_DATABASE=username_bnp_shop npm run db:migrate
```

### Step 3.3: Seed Initial Admin User
```bash
REDACTED@gmail.com REDACTED! npm run seed:admin
```

---

## 4. LoraHost Payment Bridge Configuration

BNP integrates with the **LoraHost Payment Bridge** for processing bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay, Visa, and Mastercard transactions relayed via PayStation.

### Step 4.1: Partner Registration
1. In the LoraHost Partner Console (`https://lorahost.lorapok.tech/partners`), ensure partner `bnp` is registered.
2. Add permitted return domains:
   - `https://bnp.shop`
   - `http://localhost:3000` (for development testing)
3. Note down the following credentials:
   - `LORA_BRIDGE_CLIENT_TOKEN`
   - `LORA_RETURN_HMAC_TOKEN`
   - `LORA_WEBHOOK_HMAC_TOKEN`

### Step 4.2: Callback Endpoints
- **Return URL**: `GET https://bnp.shop/payment/return`
  - Validates HMAC-SHA256 signature calculated over sorted canonical query parameters excluding `sig`.
  - Redirects customer to `/payment/success?orderNumber=...` or `/payment/failed?orderNumber=...`.
- **Webhook URL**: `POST https://bnp.shop/api/payment/webhook`
  - Validates HMAC-SHA256 signature calculated over raw request body text.
  - Updates order status to `PAID` in MySQL database.
  - Fires rich Discord embed notification to team channel.

---

## 5. Deployment Guide

### Deployment Method A: Vercel (Recommended)
1. Push repository `Maijied/BNP` to GitHub.
2. In Vercel Dashboard, click **New Project** -> Import `Maijied/BNP`.
3. Framework Preset: **Next.js**.
4. Configure all environment variables listed in Section 2.
5. Deploy.

### Deployment Method B: cPanel Node.js Application Manager
1. In cPanel, click **Setup Node.js App**.
2. Node.js version: **20.x** or higher.
3. Application Mode: **Production**.
4. Application root: `bnp`.
5. Application startup file: `server.js` or run `npm run build && npm run start`.
6. Add environment variables under **Environment variables** section.

---

## 6. End-to-End 1 BDT Live Payment Verification Runbook

Follow this step-by-step verification checklist before launching to public traffic:

1. **Visit Storefront**:
   - Navigate to `https://bnp.shop`.
   - Verify Bengali transliteration in Plate Designer: type `dhaka metro-la 11-2233` and verify instant preview rendering `ঢাকা মেট্রো-ল ১১-২২৩৩`.
   - Test toggle between Model A (285×50 mm) and Model B (200×100 mm).
   - Verify Finish No. 8 reflection effect and bolt slot cutouts.

2. **Place Test Order**:
   - Select Model A.
   - Select Mounting Kit (+৳80).
   - Enter Customer Name: `Joy Test`.
   - Enter Customer Mobile: `01700000000`.
   - Select District: `Dhaka` (verifies ৳60 delivery rate) or `Chittagong` (verifies ৳120 delivery rate).
   - Verify total calculation.
   - Check the mandatory agreement: *"I agree to send my vehicle registration certificate (bluebook) photo to WhatsApp (01914-873925)"*.
   - Click **Complete Full Advance Payment**.

3. **Gateway Redirection & Payment**:
   - Verify redirection to LoraHost Payment Bridge / PayStation checkout page.
   - Choose bKash / Sandbox bKash.
   - Complete 1 BDT test transaction.

4. **Return & Success Verification**:
   - Verify instant redirect to `https://bnp.shop/payment/return` with signed query params.
   - Verify customer land on `/payment/success?orderNumber=BNP-...`.
   - Verify green success badge, order summary, and itemized invoice slip.
   - Click **"Send Bluebook Photo via WhatsApp"** button. Confirm it opens WhatsApp to `01914-873925` with pre-filled order number and vehicle registration plate text.

5. **Discord Alert Verification**:
   - Open your Discord operations channel.
   - Confirm delivery of rich embed notification showing:
     - Order Number (clickable)
     - Customer Name & Phone
     - Stamped Plate Text in Bengali
     - Advance Amount Paid (৳ BDT)
     - Gateway Transaction ID
     - Action link to WhatsApp

6. **Admin Dashboard Verification**:
   - Navigate to `https://bnp.shop/admin/login`.
   - Enter seeded credentials (`bikesnumberplate@gmail.com`).
   - Confirm redirect to `/admin/orders`.
   - Verify the test order appears with **Payment: PAID**.
   - Test changing Manufacturing Status from `PENDING` -> `LASER_CUTTING` -> `QUALITY_INSPECTION` -> `PACKED` -> `SHIPPED`.
   - Navigate to `/admin/settings` and verify store settings (prices, delivery fees, urgency banner text) can be viewed and saved.

---

## 7. Operational Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)

### SOP 1: Customer WhatsApp Bluebook Intake & Verification
1. When a new paid order arrives via Discord notification, note the order number and plate text.
2. Wait for the customer's WhatsApp message on `01914-873925`.
3. Compare the customer's submitted vehicle registration paper photo against the stamped plate text:
   - Ensure the district, class letter, and numbers match 100%.
   - If there is any discrepancy, call customer at hotline `01632333221` or message via WhatsApp before laser cutting.
4. Once verified, update manufacturing status to `LASER_CUTTING` in the admin portal.

### SOP 2: Manual bKash "Send Money" Reconciliation
For customers who pay manually via bKash Personal Send Money to `01632333221`:
1. Customer messages WhatsApp with their Order Number and bKash TrxID.
2. Check bKash statement on `01632333221` for matching TrxID and amount.
3. Open `/admin/orders`, locate the order, and change **Payment Status** to `PAID`.
4. Input the TrxID in the order notes/records.
5. Proceed with laser-cutting workflow.

### SOP 3: 409 Duplicate Invoice Resolution
If a customer attempts payment, aborts, and immediately tries again, the system automatically appends a retry nonce (e.g. `BNP-261101-1234-R1`) so PayStation never rejects the session with HTTP 409 Conflict. No manual intervention is required.

args.Content:
# BNP: Bike Number Plate — Full-Stack Platform Walkthrough

**A Joy & Arash Enterprise Venture**  
**Repository**: [Maijied/BNP](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP)  
**Production Domain**: `https://bnp.shop` | `https://bikesnumberplate.com`  
**Contact & Operations**:  
- **Hotline & bKash Send Money**: `01632333221`  
- **WhatsApp Registration Paper Intake**: `01914-873925`  
- **Email**: `bikesnumberplate@gmail.com`  
- **Office / Workshop**: `52 Purana Paltan Line, Paltan, Dhaka`  

---

## 1. Executive Summary

The **BNP (Bike Number Plate)** platform has been fully designed, engineered, tested, and delivered across 7 sequential milestones with separate feature branches and GitHub Pull Requests (#1 through #7) merged into `main`.

The platform serves motorcycle and scooter owners across Bangladesh who need custom laser-cut 0.8 mm Finish No. 8 mirror-silver stainless steel and BRTA-compliant aluminum plates ahead of the November 15 BRTA deadline.

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                 STOREFRONT CORE                                   |
|  - Urgency Deadline Banner (BRTA Nov 15 countdown)                                |
|  - Real-Time Dual-Model Interactive Plate Studio (Model A & Model B)             |
|  - 64-District Bengali Transliteration Engine (Latin -> Bengali Unicode)         |
|  - Full Advance Payment Intake (No COD) + WhatsApp Bluebook Consent              |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                               TRANSACTION ENGINE                                  |
|  - LoraHost Payment Bridge (PayStation relay: bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Cards)        |
|  - Canonical HMAC-SHA256 Signature Verification (Return URL + Webhook)           |
|  - Automatic Retry Nonces (-R1, -R2) to prevent HTTP 409 Invoice Conflicts       |
|  - Server-Side Price & Fee Recalculation (Anti-tamper protection)                 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                          |
                      +-------------------+-------------------+
                      |                                       |
                      v                                       v
+-------------------------------------------+ +-------------------------------------+
|            ADMIN OPERATIONS               | |         NOTIFICATIONS & OPS         |
|  - Bcrypt Authentication & Jose JWT       | |  - Real-Time Discord Webhook Alerts |
|  - Order Dashboard with Search & Filters  | |  - Customer WhatsApp Direct Links   |
|  - Manufacturing Status Workflow Engine   | |  - Itemized Invoices & Print Action |
|  - Live Store Settings Configurator       | |  - Manual bKash Reconciliation SOP  |
+-------------------------------------------+ +-------------------------------------+
```

---

## 2. Completed Milestones & Pull Requests

| PR | Branch | Title | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **[#1](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/1)** | `feat/scaffold-design-tokens` | Scaffold Next.js 14 project, configure design system and base layout | Merged |
| **[#2](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/2)** | `feat/plate-designer-transliteration` | Implement Bengali transliteration engine and live interactive plate designer | Merged |
| **[#3](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/3)** | `feat/storefront-sections-order-form` | Implement storefront order intake flow, pricing synchronization, and WhatsApp verification agreement | Merged |
| **[#4](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/4)** | `feat/mysql-lorahost-payment-bridge` | Implement MySQL database layer, order creation API, and LoraHost payment bridge | Merged |
| **[#5](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/5)** | `feat/discord-webhook-and-receipts` | Implement Discord webhook alert integration and payment confirmation and failure pages | Merged |
| **[#6](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/6)** | `feat/admin-portal-order-management` | Implement admin authentication, order management dashboard, and store settings configurator | Merged |
| **[#7](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/7)** | `feat/deployment-optimization-runbook` | Add production deployment runbook and deployment documentation | Merged |

---

## 3. Key Components & Implementation Details

### 3.1. Plate Studio & Bengali Transliteration ([lib/bengali.ts](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/lib/bengali.ts), [components/PlateDesigner.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/components/PlateDesigner.tsx))
- **Live Typing**: Automatically parses Latin input into official BRTA Bengali format:
  - E.g., `Dhaka Metro LA 12-3456` -> `ঢাকা মেট্রো-ল ১২-৩৪৫৬`
  - E.g., `Cumilla HA 11-0052` -> `কুমিল্লা-হ ১১-০০৫২`
- **Dual Aspect Ratios**:
  - **Model A (Motorcycle)**: 285×50 mm (single line format, 2 side mounting slots).
  - **Model B (Scooter)**: 200×100 mm (two-line stacked format, top mounting slots).

### 3.2. Order Flow & Storefront Synchronization ([components/StorefrontContext.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/components/StorefrontContext.tsx), [components/OrderForm.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/components/OrderForm.tsx))
- **State Synchronization**: Plate configuration, model choice, mounting kit selection, and quantity synchronize instantly across Designer, Pricing Table, and Order Form.
- **Dynamic Delivery Fees**: Auto-calculated based on destination (৳60 Inside Dhaka / ৳120 Outside Dhaka).
- **Mandatory Verification Checkbox**: Enforces agreement that the customer must submit their registration certificate (bluebook) via WhatsApp (`01914-873925`) after payment.

### 3.3. Database & Payment Bridge ([lib/db.ts](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/lib/db.ts), [lib/lorahost.ts](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/lib/lorahost.ts))
- **Database**: Pure cPanel MySQL with `mysql2/promise` parameterized queries and schema definitions (`orders`, `settings`, `admins`). Includes automatic memory fallback during CI or offline development.
- **LoraHost Bridge Integration**:
  - `POST /api/payment/v1/sessions` session initialization.
  - Return URL canonical sorted query HMAC-SHA256 verification.
  - Webhook raw-body HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.
  - Automatic `-R` retry nonces preventing PayStation HTTP 409 duplicate invoice conflicts.

### 3.4. Discord Webhook & Confirmation Receipts ([lib/discord.ts](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/lib/discord.ts), [app/payment/success/page.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/app/payment/success/page.tsx))
- **Team Alerts**: Rich embeds posted to Discord with Order Number, Customer Name, Mobile, Stamped Plate Text in Bengali, Advance Amount, Transaction ID, and quick WhatsApp action button.
- **Success Receipt**: Printable invoice slip with an unmistakable green CTA: **"Send Bluebook Photo via WhatsApp"** pre-populating order details directly to `01914-873925`.

### 3.5. Admin Management Portal ([app/admin/orders/page.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/app/admin/orders/page.tsx), [app/admin/settings/page.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/app/admin/settings/page.tsx))
- **Security**: Edge middleware ([middleware.ts](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/middleware.ts)) protecting `/admin/*` routes with Jose signed JWT cookies and bcrypt password verification.
- **Order Pipeline**: Filter by payment status (`PENDING`, `PAID`, `FAILED`) and update manufacturing stages (`PENDING`, `LASER_CUTTING`, `QUALITY_INSPECTION`, `PACKED`, `SHIPPED`, `DELIVERED`).

Trails are our replacement for the pull request for agentic coding. They bring the most relevant information to the top of the page as eval scores, which are calculated on every push. The goal is simple: give you all the information you need to decide whether enough loops between your coding agent and the review agents have happened to reach a stable state, or whether another iteration is needed. Merge only when confidence is high, risk is low, and all findings are cleared. [What Are Trails?](https://www.youtube.com/embed/1o9j4w7HFFQ?list=PLPfwtjAgHCu0\&index=7) A trail can begin on Entire by filing a bug report or a feature request. Or you can start a trail straight from your agent, before or after implementation has started, like you would open a PR when you are ready to push code. A trail can span multiple repositories, so changes that belong together are grouped together. When code is pushed to a trail, Entire triggers review agents to review the commit. Each agent runs independently in a cloud sandbox and submits a score and a rationale. For example, across many of our repositories at Entire, we use Security, Slop, and Human Review Required evals. If the Slop score is orange, you can instruct your agent to keep correcting and pushing based on that data until the score turns green. Each eval shows the current run alongside the last five runs. We believe this is crucial, because a single loop often misses a critical issue. Repeating the loops until the scores stabilize is key to the success of agentic coding. ## How Do Trails Help? Trails put the context behind a change alongside the code, whether you are building a feature or reviewing someone else’s work. You can follow the decisions made during agent sessions and see what still needs attention before merging. For example, a trail for account recovery can begin with acceptance criteria, collect changes to the API and frontend, and bring together agent findings, CI results, and human approvals. Each change is reviewed and merged separately. ## What Can You Do with Trails? * **Capture intent early.** Create a trail with a title, description, type, assignees, and priority before attaching code. * **Follow the work.** Link branches as changes and keep their commits, checkpoints, and agent sessions together. * **Evaluate changes with agents.** Configure [Agents](https://docs.entire.com/guides/trails/agents.md) to review changes and report findings and signals. Automatic runs depend on each agent’s enabled trigger, repository selection, readiness condition, and branch or path filters. * **Review with context.** Inspect each change’s diff, findings, sessions, and timeline alongside the trail’s intended outcome. * **Set merge requirements.** Configure [Gates](https://docs.entire.com/guides/trails/gates.md) for requirements such as branch freshness, human approvals, findings, and supported CI checks. * **Work from your coding agent.** Ask your agent to use the Entire CLI to create or update a trail and investigate its findings. Have it run `entire agent-help` first to discover the available commands. For example, send this prompt to Codex or another coding agent: ```text theme={null} Run `entire agent-help`, then inspect the Entire trail linked to this branch. # 🛸 Loragent Entire Specialist (v1.0.0)

> **Role**: Entire CLI & Entire Trails Orchestrator  
> **Ecosystem**: Lorapok Labs (`lorapok.tech`) & Loragent Multi-Agent Framework  
> **Forge**: Entire (`https://entire.com`, `https://docs.entire.com`)  
> **Formation:** auto | **Layer (LLDP):** cross | **Category:** vcs

---

## §1 · Role & Identity

**What this agent IS:**
The **Entire Specialist** is the primary autonomous authority within the **Loragent Ecosystem** for operating the Entire Git forge, Entire CLI, session capture infrastructure, and Trails workflow. Scope:
- Initializing and verifying Entire CLI installation (`entire version`, `entire status`, `entire doctor`).
- Managing the **Entire Trails lifecycle** (`entire trail create`, `entire trail link`, `entire trail show`, `entire trail watch`, `entire trail approvals`, `entire trail approve`, `entire trail merge`).
- Enforcing **Eval Gates** (Risk Monitor, Intent Drift Monitor, Slop Detector, CI integration) before code changes are merged.
- Linking branches across repositories into unified Trails to represent holistic product features.
- Inspecting agent sessions, tool call traces, and token usage via `entire session` and `entire checkpoint`.
- Driving agentic code exploration using `entire search` and `entire why`.
- Facilitating multi-agent collaboration across Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, and Pi.

**What this agent is NOT:**
- Not a replacement for git core operations (works alongside `git-specialist`).
- Not an interactive prompt blocker (always runs in non-interactive agent environments using CLI flags).

**Reporting to:** `loragent-boss` (via `loragent_steer`) or direct invocation.  
**Hands off to:** `loragent-boss` or `loragent-sqa` upon trail gate verification.

---

## §2 · Core Entire CLI Commands & Capabilities

The Entire CLI auto-detects repositories from git origin. Read subcommands directly from `entire agent-help`:

```bash
# Discover machine-readable command structure
entire agent-help
entire agent-help trail
entire agent-help checkpoint
entire agent-help session

# Check status and active agent sessions
entire status
```

### 1. Trail Management (`entire trail`)
Trails replace conventional PRs with eval-driven agent review:
- **Create Trail with Planning Intent (No Branch)**:
  ```bash
  entire trail create \
    --title "Feature Name" \
    --no-branch \
    --body "Detailed acceptance criteria, problem statement, and expected outcomes." \
    --type feature \
    --priority medium
  ```
- **Create Trail with Active Feature Branch**:
  ```bash
  entire trail create --title "Feature Name"
  ```
- **Link Existing Branch to Trail**:
  ```bash
  entire trail link <trail-id> --branch <branch-name>
  ```
- **Inspect Trail Status, Evals & Gates**:
  ```bash
  entire trail show <trail-id>
  ```
- **Watch Live Evaluation Progress**:
  ```bash
  entire trail watch <trail-id>
  ```

### 2. Session & Checkpoint Auditing
- **List Tracked Sessions**:
  ```bash
  entire session list
  ```
- **Inspect Active Session Details**:
  ```bash
  entire session show <session-id>
  ```
- **List Checkpoints Linked to Commits**:
  ```bash
  entire checkpoint list
  ```
- **Explain Intent Behind a Change**:
  ```bash
  entire checkpoint explain <commit-or-checkpoint>
  ```

### 3. Agentic Code Search & Why Exploration
- **Search Past Sessions & Decisions**:
  ```bash
  entire search "payment bridge HMAC signature"
  ```
- **Trace Why a Line of Code Exists**:
  ```bash
  entire why <file>:<line-number>
  ```

---

## §3 · Trail Evaluation Gates (Risk, Intent Drift, Slop)

When agents push code to an Entire Trail, cloud review agents evaluate the commit against preconfigured gates:
1. **Risk Score**: Evaluates potential breaking changes, security vulnerabilities, and database schema mutations. Target: `< 10%`.
2. **Intent Drift**: Measures divergence from the original Trail title and body acceptance criteria. Target: `< 5%`.
3. **Slop Monitor**: Detects hallucinated boilerplate, unused abstractions, or repetitive comments. Target: `Low` / `Green`.
4. **Checks & CI**: Verifies unit test coverage, build pipelines, and linting suites pass 100%.

**Agent Rule**: If any score is orange or red, loop with your coding agent to fix findings before requesting human approval or merge.

---

## §4 · Loragent Ecosystem Integration

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                              Loragent Boss                              |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                     |
                                     v
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                       Loragent Entire Specialist                        |
|  - Creates & updates Trails                                             |
|  - Enforces eval gates & checks                                         |
|  - Audits session transcripts & checkpoints                             |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                               /           \
                              /             \
                             v               v
            +--------------------+       +--------------------+
            |   Git Specialist   |       |     SQA Lead       |
            | (branches/rebases) |       |  (eval verifier)   |
            +--------------------+       +--------------------+
```

1. **Autonomous Handoff**:
   When a milestone begins, `loragent-entire-specialist` initializes or updates the Trail.
2. **Commit Checkpointing**:
   `entire` hooks automatically link the local agent session (`Antigravity`, `Claude Code`, etc.) to the git commit and sync checkpoint refs to remote on push.
3. **Post-Push Eval Review**:
   After pushing, `loragent-entire-specialist` inspects `entire trail show` to verify review agents approve the change without blocking findings.

195: ## 7. Operational Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)
196: 
197: ### SOP 1: Customer WhatsApp Bluebook Intake & Verification
198: 1. When a new paid order arrives via Discord notification, note the order number and plate text.
199: 2. Wait for the customer's WhatsApp message on `01914-873925`.
200: 3. Compare the customer's submitted vehicle registration paper photo against the stamped plate text:
201:    - Ensure the district, class letter, and numbers match 100%.
202:    - If there is any discrepancy, call customer at hotline `01632333221` or message via WhatsApp before laser cutting.
203: 4. Once verified, update manufacturing status to `LASER_CUTTING` in the admin portal.
204: 
205: ### SOP 2: Manual bKash "Send Money" Reconciliation
206: For customers who pay manually via bKash Personal Send Money to `01632333221`:
207: 1. Customer messages WhatsApp with their Order Number and bKash TrxID.
208: 2. Check bKash statement on `01632333221` for matching TrxID and amount.
209: 3. Open `/admin/orders`, locate the order, and change **Payment Status** to `PAID`.
210: 4. Input the TrxID in the order notes/records.
211: 5. Proceed with laser-cutting workflow.
212: 
213: ### SOP 3: 409 Duplicate Invoice Resolution
214: If a customer attempts payment, aborts, and immediately tries again, the system automatically appends a retry nonce (e.g. `BNP-261101-1234-R1`) so PayStation never rejects the session with HTTP 409 Conflict. No manual intervention is required.

## 8. Entire CLI & Entire Trails Workflow

The BNP repository integrates with **Entire** (`https://entire.com`) for tracking agent sessions, intent, checkpoints, and eval gates:

- **Entire Status**: Check active agent sessions and outgoing checkpoints:
  ```bash
  entire status
  ```
- **Entire Trails**: Manage intent and eval-driven PR reviews:
  ```bash
  entire trail create --title "Feature Name" --no-branch --body "Description" --type feature --priority high
  entire trail link <trail-id> --branch <branch-name>
  entire trail show <trail-id>
  ```
- **Loragent Entire Specialist**: Automated orchestration agent available in Loragent:
  - Invoked via `loragent-entire-specialist` for managing trails, verifying eval scores (Risk, Intent Drift, Slop), and reviewing session checkpoints.

### SOP 3: 409 Duplicate Invoice Resolution
If a customer attempts payment, aborts, and immediately tries again, the system automatically appends a retry nonce (e.g. `BNP-261101-1234-R1`) so PayStation never rejects the session with HTTP 409 Conflict. No manual intervention is required.

# BNP: Bike Number Plate — Full-Stack Platform & Strategic Partnership Walkthrough

**A Joy & Arash Enterprise Venture in Strategic Partnership with Lorapok Labs & LoraHost**  
**Repository**: [Maijied/BNP](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP)  
**Loragent Framework**: [Maijied/Loragent](https://github.com/Maijied/Loragent)  
**Live Production & Sandbox Domain**: `https://bnp.lorapok.tech` (and `https://bnp.shop`)  
**Entire Trail**: [Entire Trail #8](https://entire.com/gh/maijied/-/trails/8)  

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Partnership Architecture

The **BNP (Bike Number Plate)** platform has been fully developed, hardened, tested, and branded to showcase a top-tier commercial venture:
- **Founders & Enterprise**: Joy & Arash • *A Joy & Arash Enterprise Venture*.
- **Technology & Design Partner**: **Lorapok Labs** ([lorapok.tech](https://lorapok.tech)) — Creator of the Biological UI / Sensory Computing design philosophy.
- **Sovereign Payment Infrastructure**: **LoraHost** ([lorahost.lorapok.tech](https://lorahost.lorapok.tech)) — LiteSpeed NVMe cloud clusters & automated PayStation PGW relay (bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay, Visa, Mastercard).
- **Agent Collaboration & Forge**: **Entire** ([entire.com](https://entire.com)) — Multi-agent intent tracking, checkpoints, and eval gates (Risk, Intent Drift, Slop).

```
                      +----------------------------------------------------+
                      |     BNP Storefront (https://bnp.lorapok.tech)       |
                      |  - Top Strategic Partnership & Sandbox Ribbon       |
                      |  - Co-branded Navbar (BNP × Lorapok Labs × LoraHost)|
                      |  - Interactive Biological UI Plate Studio           |
                      |  - 64-District BRTA Bengali Transliteration Engine  |
                      |  - Exclusive LoraHost Payment Gateway Integration   |
                      +----------------------------------------------------+
                                                |
                                                v
                      +----------------------------------------------------+
                      |            TRANSACTION & OPERATIONS ENGINE         |
                      |  - LoraHost Payment Bridge (PayStation v2 Relay)   |
                      |  - Dual Canonical HMAC-SHA256 Signature Security   |
                      |  - Automatic Retry Nonces (-R1, -R2) for 409 Drops |
                      |  - Real-Time Discord Operations Webhook Alerts     |
                      |  - Customer WhatsApp Registration Paper Upload CTA |
                      +----------------------------------------------------+
                                                |
                      +-------------------------+--------------------------+
                      |                                                    |
                      v                                                    v
+-------------------------------------------+    +------------------------------------------+
|          ADMIN OPERATIONS PORTAL          |    |        LORAGENT ENTIRE SPECIALIST        |
|  - Jose Signed JWT & Bcrypt Authentication|    |  - Entire CLI & Session Management       |
|  - Live Order Pipeline & WhatsApp Chat CTA|    |  - Entire Trails #8 Lifecycle Automation |
|  - Dynamic Store Configurator             |    |  - Risk, Drift & Slop Gate Auditing     |
+-------------------------------------------+    +------------------------------------------+
```

---

## 2. Completed Milestones & Merged Pull Requests

### BNP Repository (`Maijied/BNP`)

| PR | Branch | Milestone Description | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **[#1](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/1)** | `feat/scaffold-design-tokens` | Scaffold Next.js 14 project, configure design system and base layout | Merged |
| **[#2](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/2)** | `feat/plate-designer-transliteration` | Bengali transliteration engine (64 districts) and interactive Plate Studio (Model A & B) | Merged |
| **[#3](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/3)** | `feat/storefront-sections-order-form` | Storefront synchronization, dynamic delivery pricing, and WhatsApp bluebook consent | Merged |
| **[#4](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/4)** | `feat/mysql-lorahost-payment-bridge` | MySQL database layer, order creation API, and LoraHost Payment Bridge (HMAC-SHA256) | Merged |
| **[#5](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/5)** | `feat/discord-webhook-and-receipts` | Server-side Discord webhook notifications, invoice receipt, and WhatsApp upload CTA | Merged |
| **[#6](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/6)** | `feat/admin-portal-order-management` | Admin authentication (bcrypt + JWT), order management dashboard, and store configurator | Merged |
| **[#7](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/7)** | `feat/deployment-optimization-runbook` | Production deployment runbook, cPanel MySQL guide, and 1 BDT live verification checklist | Merged |
| **[#8](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP/pull/8)** | `feat/lorapok-lorahost-partnership-branding` | Exclusive LoraHost payment gateway, Lorapok Labs partnership branding, and `bnp.lorapok.tech` sandbox | Merged |

### Loragent Framework Repository (`Maijied/Loragent`)

| PR | Branch | Milestone Description | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **[#4](https://github.com/Maijied/Loragent/pull/4)** | `feat/loragent-entire-specialist` | Add Loragent Entire Specialist for Entire CLI, Trails, and agent session tracking | Merged |

---

## 3. Key Enhancements Delivered in Milestone 8

### 3.1. Exclusive LoraHost Payment Gateway ([components/OrderForm.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/components/OrderForm.tsx), [components/PaymentSection.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/components/PaymentSection.tsx))
- Storefront order checkout is exclusively routed through the **LoraHost Payment Bridge** (`https://lorahost.lorapok.tech/api/payment-bridge/v1/sessions`).
- Full support for bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay, Visa, Mastercard, and AMEX relayed securely via PayStation.
- Seamless 1-click gateway redirection with automatic `-R` retry nonces preventing PayStation HTTP 409 conflict errors.
- 100% automated instant verification with cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signatures.

### 3.2. Strategic Partnership Branding
- **Top Urgency Bar** ([components/UrgencyBar.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/components/UrgencyBar.tsx)): Displays live sandbox pill (`bnp.lorapok.tech • Sandbox`), clickable links to [Lorapok Labs](https://lorapok.tech) and [LoraHost](https://lorahost.lorapok.tech), and BRTA Nov 15 deadline countdown.
- **Navbar** ([components/Navbar.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/components/Navbar.tsx)): Co-branded header featuring `BNP × Lorapok Labs × LoraHost` pill with glowing status indicators and venture attribution to Joy & Arash.
- **Hero Section** ([components/Hero.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/components/Hero.tsx)): Dedicated partnership showcase card highlighting Lorapok Labs Biological UI and LoraHost sovereign payment infrastructure.
- **Pricing & Specifications** ([components/Pricing.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/components/Pricing.tsx)): LoraHost payment gateway trust seals and pre-order discount badges.
- **Footer** ([components/Footer.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/components/Footer.tsx)): Comprehensive partnership overview cards for Lorapok Labs and LoraHost with verified live links.
- **Payment Receipt** ([app/payment/success/page.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/app/payment/success/page.tsx)): Co-branded verification badge and pre-filled WhatsApp bluebook submission action (`01914-873925`).
- **Admin Management Hub** ([app/admin/orders/page.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/app/admin/orders/page.tsx), [app/admin/settings/page.tsx](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/app/admin/settings/page.tsx)): Co-branded administration bar.

### 3.3. Loragent Entire Specialist (`loragent-entire-specialist`)
- Created autonomous agent in `/mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/loragent/agents/entire-specialist/SKILL.md` and `/mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/loragent/skills/loragent-entire-specialist/SKILL.md`.
- Governs Entire CLI operations (`entire version`, `entire status`, `entire checkpoint`, `entire session`, `entire search`, `entire why`).
- Automates Entire Trails lifecycle (`entire trail create`, `entire trail link`, `entire trail show`, `entire trail watch`).
- Enforces evaluation gates (Risk Monitor, Intent Drift, Slop Monitor, CI checks) for multi-agent workflows across Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, and Pi.
- Registered across Loragent marketplace (`registry/marketplace.json`) and `AGENT_INDEX.md`.

Detailed architecture and release documentation are available in the updated [BNP Final Walkthrough Artifact](file:///home/maizied/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/4c171963-3ff2-4436-8e0b-e7a20eaabae7/bnp_final_walkthrough.md).

2. **Strategic Partnership & Lorapok Labs Branding**:
   - **Urgency Ribbon** ([`UrgencyBar.tsx`](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/components/UrgencyBar.tsx)): `bnp.lorapok.tech • Sandbox` live badge with links to [Lorapok Labs](https://lorapok.tech) & [LoraHost](https://lorahost.lorapok.tech).

   - **Pricing & Payment** ([`Pricing.tsx`](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/components/Pricing.tsx), [`PaymentSection.tsx`](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/components/PaymentSection.tsx)): Trust badges and deep breakdown of the automated LoraHost PGW.
   - **Footer** ([`Footer.tsx`](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/components/Footer.tsx)): Dedicated partnership profile cards with direct links to `lorapok.tech` and `lorahost.lorapok.tech`.
   - **Success Receipt & Admin** ([`page.tsx`](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/app/payment/success/page.tsx), [`orders/page.tsx`](file:///mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/BNP/app/admin/orders/page.tsx)): Co-branded verification badges.

3. **New Loragent Agent: Entire Specialist (`loragent-entire-specialist`)**:
   - Authored and registered in `/mnt/NewVolume/Personal_Projects/loragent/agents/entire-specialist/SKILL.md`.
   - Governs the Entire CLI (`entire version`, `entire status`, `entire checkpoint`, `entire session`, `entire search`, `entire why`).
   - Automates Entire Trails (`entire trail create`, `entire trail link`, `entire trail watch`), tracking changes across branches and multi-agent sessions.

   - Regenerated and synced in Loragent's `registry/marketplace.json` (316 items) and `AGENT_INDEX.md`.

4. **Live Verification & Build**:
   - `npm run test:bengali` passed (5/5 cases).

   - `npm run build` passed (16/16 routes compiled successfully).

8: ## 1. Why the Credential Vault Idea is Essential
9: 
10: Traditional workflows store API keys and secrets in `.env` files or hardcode them in local configs. This creates critical security vulnerabilities:
11: 1. **Accidental Git Leakage**: Developers frequently stage and push `.env` files containing live credentials to GitHub.
12: 2. **Terminal & Process Exposure**: Passing keys in command-line arguments (e.g. `cmd --api-key=REDACTED exposes plaintext secrets in `ps aux` and shell history.
13: 3. **AI Chat Logging**: Copy-pasting raw tokens into AI chat transcripts exposes keys in LLM prompt histories and log traces.

71: # Loragent GitHub Domain Verifier
72: 
73: Automates and verifies custom domains, apex domains, and organization-approved domain verification challenges (`_gh-<org>-o`) for GitHub Pages and GitHub Enterprise/Organization settings. Integrates directly with Cloudflare DNS API using zero-trust credential vault encryption and validates global propagation across recursive resolvers.
74: 
75: ## Verification Workflow
76: 
77: ```
78: [ GitHub Domain Challenge (Hostname + Token) ]
79:                        │
80:                        ▼
81:    [ loragent-domain-verify / Cloudflare DNS API ]
82:  (Extracts zone & authenticates via TiTi Vault PIN)
83:                        │
84:                        ▼
85:        [ TXT Record Deployed to Cloudflare ]
86:   (_gh-<org>-o.<subdomain>.<domain> -> <challenge_token>)
87:                        │

90: (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Google 8.8.8.8, Quad9 9.9.9.9, DoH)
91:                        │
92:                        ▼
93:     [ GitHub Verification Ready & Auto-Confirm ]
94: ```
95: 
96: ## CLI Commands

98: ```bash
99: # Check propagation of existing record
100: node bin/loragent-domain-verify.js check _gh-Lorapok-o.loragent.lorapok.tech f697b6ac08
101: 
102: # Deploy TXT record to Cloudflare DNS
103: node bin/loragent-domain-verify.js create _gh-Lorapok-o.loragent.lorapok.tech f697b6ac08
104: 
105: # Complete end-to-end deploy & verification

110:

113: ```

116: 
117: - **Zero-Trust PIN Manager:** In-memory authorization PIN resolution via `src/lore/auth/pin-manager.js` and `.cred-vault-passphrase`.
118: - **Vault Decryption:** Transient decryption of symmetric AES-256 vault (`credentials.json.gpg`) without writing plaintext to disk.
119: - **Scope Isolation:** Cloudflare DNS management scope restricted to target zone (`lorapok.tech`).

195: ## 7. Operational Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)
196: 
197: ### SOP 1: Customer WhatsApp Bluebook Intake & Verification
198: 1. When a new paid order arrives via Discord notification, note the order number and plate text.
199: 2. Wait for the customer's WhatsApp message on `01914-873925`.
200: 3. Compare the customer's submitted vehicle registration paper photo against the stamped plate text:
201:    - Ensure the district, class letter, and numbers match 100%.
202:    - If there is any discrepancy, call customer at hotline `01632333221` or message via WhatsApp before laser cutting.
203: 4. Once verified, update manufacturing status to `LASER_CUTTING` in the admin portal.
204: 
205: ### SOP 2: Manual bKash "Send Money" Reconciliation
206: For customers who pay manually via bKash Personal Send Money to `01632333221`:
207: 1. Customer messages WhatsApp with their Order Number and bKash TrxID.
208: 2. Check bKash statement on `01632333221` for matching TrxID and amount.
209: 3. Open `/admin/orders`, locate the order, and change **Payment Status** to `PAID`.
210: 4. Input the TrxID in the order notes/records.
211: 5. Proceed with laser-cutting workflow.
212: 
213: ### SOP 3: 409 Duplicate Invoice Resolution
214: If a customer attempts payment, aborts, and immediately tries again, the system automatically appends a retry nonce (e.g. `BNP-261101-1234-R1`) so PayStation never rejects the session with HTTP 409 Conflict. No manual intervention is required.
215:

## 9. Cloudflare Pages & Functions Architecture (`bnp.lorapok.tech`)

The live storefront and sandbox portal is hosted on **Cloudflare Pages** under `https://bnp.lorapok.tech`:

- **Pages Project**: `bnp` (`bnp-6ej.pages.dev`)
- **Custom Domain**: `bnp.lorapok.tech` (Cloudflare SSL / HTTP/2 proxy)
- **Static Assets (`out/`)**: Next.js 14 static export with optimized interactive client components (`next build` with `output: "export"`).
- **Edge Functions (`functions/`)**: Cloudflare Pages Functions execute dynamically on Cloudflare V8 Workers:
  - `functions/api/order.js`: Order validation, dynamic pricing calculation, and session creation with LoraHost Payment Bridge.
  - `functions/api/order/[orderNumber].js`: Dynamic receipt and order status lookup.
  - `functions/api/payment/webhook.js`: LoraHost Payment Bridge callback ingestion.
  - `functions/api/admin/*`: Lightweight edge admin authentication and management endpoints.
- **Continuous Deployment**: Automated build on GitHub push via `npm run build` with `destination_dir: "out"`.
